C(n, k) = n! / (k!(n-k)!)

Here, n = 7 and k = 3. Plugging in the values:

C(7, 3) = 7! / (3! * 4!)

We can simplify by expanding the factorials and canceling out the 4! from the denominator:

C(7, 3) = (7 × 6 × 5 × 4!) / (3! × 4!)
C(7, 3) = (7 × 6 × 5) / (3 × 2 × 1)

Now, calculate the numerator and denominator:
Numerator: 7 × 6 × 5 = 210
Denominator: 3 × 2 × 1 = 6

Divide the results:
210 / 6 = 35

ANSWER: 35
